metadata.description: Comma-separated full resource IDs of target resource groups. The Automation identity receives Virtual Machine Contributor on each group.
Deployment timestamp used to choose a future first run for the daily schedule.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicConfirmRemoval
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Must be true, together with Operation=Remove, before remediation is allowed.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicMaximumCandidateCount
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Safety ceiling for confirmed ghost NIC candidates on one VM.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicExclusionTagName
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: VM tag used to exclude scanning or removal.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicScanExclusionValues
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Comma-separated tag values that prevent scanning.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicRemovalExclusionValues
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Comma-separated tag values that prevent removal while allowing detection.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicPnpCleanWaitSeconds
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Seconds to wait after PnpClean before pnputil fallback.

runtimeVariableDefinitions.name: GhostNicRequireProblemCode45
runtimeVariableDefinitions.description: Require CM_PROB_PHANTOM code 45 before pnputil removal.

properties.description: One or more target resource-group IDs, separated by commas, semicolons, or new lines.
Detects or explicitly removes Windows Azure ghosted NIC entries through VM Run Command.
Runs Ghost NIC detection daily at 12:30 PM Pacific time. Administrators can adjust this schedule in Azure Automation.
Idempotently links the Ghost NIC maintenance runbook to its daily schedule.
